sloka: आविष्टम् तेजसा रामम् संग्राम शिरसि स्थितम् ।दृष्ट्वा सर्वाणि भूतानि भयात् विव्यथिरे तदा ॥३-२४-२५॥
transliteration: āviṣṭam tejasā rāmam saṁgrāma śirasi sthitam ।dṛṣṭvā sarvāṇi bhūtāni bhayāt vivyathire tadā ॥3-24-25॥

translations.english: Seeing Rama standing on the war front, engrossed and radiating heroic lustre, all beings were alarmed.
